stages.title: 1. Reliable observations
stages.question: What can these measurements tell us?

stages.title: 4. Deliver and defend
stages.question: Can someone check and reuse the result?

blocks.practice: State the observation unit; document missingness and provenance.
blocks.evidence: An audit with one justified quality decision

blocks.practice: Select, derive and summarise a small sensor table; check by hand.
blocks.evidence: An explained calculation and a rerunnable notebook

blocks.practice: Aggregate observations and join sensor metadata without duplication.
blocks.evidence: A checked join and a quality record

blocks.practice: Explain distribution plots, centred products and common-row matrices.
blocks.evidence: A statistical profile and a qualified joint claim

blocks.practice: Choose a split; fit preprocessing on training rows; evaluate a baseline.
blocks.evidence: A leakage-safe pipeline and a project question

blocks.practice: Use a stable solver; inspect residuals and numerical conditioning.
blocks.evidence: A checked fit with residual interpretation

blocks.practice: Fit logistic/softmax models; interpret confusion counts and metrics.
blocks.evidence: A justified metric and decision threshold

blocks.practice: Demonstrate the foundations; begin the regularisation/CV comparison.
blocks.evidence: Individual evidence, then a regularisation prediction

blocks.practice: Search over full pipelines and interpret learning curves.
Compare a tree and forest; explain a supplied boosting comparison.
blocks.evidence: A model comparison with interpretation limits

blocks.practice: Project the data; compare k-means, hierarchical and density geometries.
blocks.evidence: A geometric interpretation and a stability check

blocks.practice: Measure a columnar workflow and rerun a documented analysis.
blocks.evidence: A measured comparison and reproducible delivery

blocks.practice: Defend the question, data decisions, baseline and selection procedure.
blocks.evidence: A revised project and result card

blocks.practice: Audit an analysis and connect the mathematical and computational choices.
blocks.evidence: An individual validity audit and course synthesis
